purpose: Review official Taiwan/NLSC and Chiayi land-office channels for safe anonymous cadastral geometry and stable parcel identifiers.
assessment: Chiayi local land administration is evidenced by the official Chiayi cadastral-information service. NLSC public WFS capabilities and DescribeFeatureType expose a cadastral layer and polygon schema, but the exact unchanged WUP-point GetFeature request returned Permission Denied. No geometry or native parcel identity was retained.
registryAssessment: The official Chiayi land-information service states that cadastral information is provided by local city/county land authorities and specifically offers Chiayi cadastral-map services. This establishes local registry/service custody, not unrestricted anonymous vector access.
